decisions.reason: While the authors replicated the within-condition crowd-within effect in both conditions, their pre-registered confirmatory test of Vul and Pashler's (2008) delay advantage relative to guess 1 did not replicate and is explicitly contrasted with the original in Section 3.2 ('unlike in Vul and Pashler (2008)'). Under the codebook, confirming the named effect while explicitly contrasting another tested finding with the original requires coding the outcome as 'mixed'.
